card.name: Right before a named political figure
card.fires_on: Linking words or punctuation just before a historical person's name, mostly in history texts about the Dreyfus affair and US presidents. It fires on words like for, of, and, comma or bracket that lead into the name.

modes.description: A word such as of, for or and right before the name of a president or statesman.
